# Repository map

<!-- GENERATED by scripts/ai/sync.mjs from line 1 of each source file. Do not edit: change the source, then run `npm run ai:sync`. -->

One line per file. Read this instead of opening files to find where something lives.

## config/
- `config/devices.ts`: Device matrix: browser/device groups selectable with DEVICES=.

## demo-app/
- `demo-app/server.mjs`: Local demo system under test: multi-tenant UI + REST API + file exports + a Salesforce REST/SOQL mock,

## scripts/ai/
- `scripts/ai/context-pack.mjs`: Builds a token-budgeted, task-specific context pack for ANY model or chat UI (local Llama/Qwen via Ollama, Gemini, ChatGPT, Claude.ai…).
- `scripts/ai/sync.mjs`: Generates every AI tool's config from the single source of truth in ai/ (+ AGENTS.md). Zero dependencies.

## scripts/
- `scripts/lint-locators.mjs`: Enforces the LOCATOR STANDARD (docs/LOCATOR-STANDARD.md). Zero dependencies; runs in CI and pre-commit.
- `scripts/make-sample-excel.ts`: Generates data/excel/appointment-cases.xlsx from code (reviewable sample test data).

## src/clients/api/
- `src/clients/api/ApiClient.ts`: Typed API client over Playwright APIRequestContext: status checks, zod schemas, read-only guard, auth.

## src/clients/db/
- `src/clients/db/PostgresClient.ts`: PostgreSQL client: pooled, parameterized queries, transactions, polling, read-only guard.

## src/clients/salesforce/
- `src/clients/salesforce/SalesforceTokenManager.ts`: Salesforce OAuth token manager (JWT Bearer / Client Credentials), one token per worker.
- `src/clients/salesforce/SoqlClient.ts`: Salesforce SOQL client: pagination, re-auth, polling, injection-safe soql`` template.

## src/config/
- `src/config/ConfigManager.ts`: Loads config/environments/<env>.json + tenant overrides + secrets into a frozen AppConfig.
- `src/config/HealthCheck.ts`: Pre-flight health check of UI, API, PostgreSQL and Salesforce for the active env/tenant.
- `src/config/env.schema.ts`: zod schema for config/environments/*.json (secrets referenced by env-var name).
- `src/config/secrets.ts`: Secret resolution (<ENV>_<TENANT>_<NAME> → <ENV>_<NAME> → <NAME>) and log masking.

## src/core/locators/
- `src/core/locators/SmartLocator.ts`: Self-healing locator: primary strategy, ordered fallbacks, heal reporting, stale-DOM retry.
- `src/core/locators/bindLocators.ts`: bindLocators(): turns a *.locators.ts map into SmartLocators for a page or component root.
- `src/core/locators/index.ts`: Public API of the locator engine (types, SmartLocator, bindLocators).
- `src/core/locators/locator.types.ts`: Types for the locator standard: LocatorStrategy, LocatorDef, LocatorMap.

## src/core/
- `src/core/logger.ts`: Leveled logger: one line per message, secrets masked.

## src/data/
- `src/data/TestDataProvider.ts`: Single entry point for test data: Excel, JSON, CSV, PostgreSQL, SOQL, API, all zod-validated.

## src/data/builders/
- `src/data/builders/appointment-case.builder.ts`: Builds an appointment test case from Excel + JSON + PostgreSQL + Salesforce (Example E).

## src/data/sources/
- `src/data/sources/excel.source.ts`: Excel reader: worksheet rows as objects, ignoring blank columns and rows.
- `src/data/sources/file.sources.ts`: JSON and CSV readers for test data files.

## src/files/
- `src/files/FileValidator.ts`: File validation: name, extension, real MIME type (magic bytes), size, CSV/XLSX/JSON structure.
- `src/files/SecureFileSystem.ts`: Sandboxed per-test file system: traversal/symlink protection, safe names, allowlist, quota.

## src/fixtures/
- `src/fixtures/clients.fixture.ts`: Fixture layer 1: api, apiToken, db, sf clients.
- `src/fixtures/config.fixture.ts`: Fixture layer 0: resolved environment + tenant config.
- `src/fixtures/data.fixture.ts`: Fixture layer 2: testData provider and cleanup registry.
- `src/fixtures/files.fixture.ts`: Fixture layer 2: per-test SecureFileSystem sandbox.
- `src/fixtures/index.ts`: The `test` object for every spec: merges all fixture layers.
- `src/fixtures/ui.fixture.ts`: Fixture layer 2: page objects (register new pages here).

## src/reporters/
- `src/reporters/self-heal.reporter.ts`: Reporter: collects self-heal events into test-results/self-heal-report.json.

## src/schemas/
- `src/schemas/appointment.schemas.ts`: zod contracts for the appointments domain: API responses and test-data rows.

## src/ui/components/data-table/
- `src/ui/components/data-table/data-table.component.ts`: Reusable DataTable component: rows as objects, find/expect rows by column values.
- `src/ui/components/data-table/data-table.locators.ts`: Locators for the DataTable component (scoped to the table root).

## src/ui/components/dropdown/
- `src/ui/components/dropdown/dropdown.component.ts`: Reusable custom dropdown component (ARIA combobox + listbox).
- `src/ui/components/dropdown/dropdown.locators.ts`: Locators for the Dropdown component.

## src/ui/components/
- `src/ui/components/index.ts`: Public exports of reusable UI components.

## src/ui/components/modal/
- `src/ui/components/modal/modal.component.ts`: Reusable Modal (dialog) component: open/closed state, title, error, buttons.
- `src/ui/components/modal/modal.locators.ts`: Locators for the Modal component (scoped to the dialog root).

## src/ui/components/toast/
- `src/ui/components/toast/toast.component.ts`: Reusable Toast component: waits for and reads notifications.
- `src/ui/components/toast/toast.locators.ts`: Locators for the Toast component.

## src/ui/pages/cura/
- `src/ui/pages/cura/cura-appointment.locators.ts`: Locators for the CURA appointment and confirmation pages.
- `src/ui/pages/cura/cura-appointment.page.ts`: Page object: CURA appointment booking and confirmation.
- `src/ui/pages/cura/cura-login.locators.ts`: Locators for the CURA home and login pages.
- `src/ui/pages/cura/cura-login.page.ts`: Page object: CURA home and login.

## src/ui/pages/demo/
- `src/ui/pages/demo/appointments.locators.ts`: Locators for the demo /appointments page and its new-appointment dialog.
- `src/ui/pages/demo/appointments.page.ts`: Page object: demo appointments page composed of Modal, Dropdown, DataTable, Toast (Example D).
- `src/ui/pages/demo/login.locators.ts`: Locators for the demo login page (Example A).
- `src/ui/pages/demo/login.page.ts`: Page object: demo login page (Example A consumer).

## tests/api/
- `tests/api/patients.api.spec.ts`: API tests: auth, tenant isolation, POST/GET with schema checks, PostgreSQL cross-check (Example C).

## tests/db/
- `tests/db/data-integrity.db.spec.ts`: Read-only database integrity tests (safe in prod).

## tests/setup/
- `tests/setup/health.setup.ts`: Health gate project: fails fast when a required environment component is down.

## tests/showcase/
- `tests/showcase/master-showcase.spec.ts`: Master showcase: one test using every framework layer end to end (Example I).

## tests/ui/cura/
- `tests/ui/cura/appointment-booking.spec.ts`: CURA demo-site UI tests (ported originals), CSV-driven.

## tests/ui/demo/
- `tests/ui/demo/appointments.spec.ts`: Demo app UI tests: dropdown vs Salesforce, validation, create + table check.

## tests/ui/
- `tests/ui/seed.spec.ts`: Seed test used by the Playwright AI agents to open the app with framework fixtures.

## tests/unit/
- `tests/unit/config-and-data.spec.ts`: Self-tests: config/secrets, Excel source, locator linter.
- `tests/unit/files.spec.ts`: Self-tests: FileValidator and SecureFileSystem.
- `tests/unit/smart-locator.spec.ts`: Self-tests: SmartLocator healing, strict/off modes, factories.

## config/environments/
- `config/environments/cura.json`: environment definition (validated by src/config/env.schema.ts)
- `config/environments/local.json`: environment definition (validated by src/config/env.schema.ts)
- `config/environments/prod.json`: environment definition (validated by src/config/env.schema.ts)
- `config/environments/qa.json`: environment definition (validated by src/config/env.schema.ts)
- `config/environments/stage.json`: environment definition (validated by src/config/env.schema.ts)
